description: Dialog for inserting or editing a structured hyperlink on a cell. Supports four link kinds: Web, Email, InternalRef and NamedRange (named ranges come from the workbook). The dialog rides the core TmModal frame: the initial focus is the target field ("hl-target"), Escape dismisses through the frame's document-level listener and the focus returns to the grid (RestoreFocusTargetId). Ctrl+Enter saves from any form field; the footer buttons are the frame's own and never double-activate. The target field switches its inputmode with the kind (url / email). The form-field ids (#hl-type, #hl-target, #hl-subject, #hl-display, #hl-tooltip) are a published E2E contract and one dialog is open at a time.

parameters.name: Workbook
parameters.description: The workbook (used for named range choices).

parameters.name: Hyperlink
parameters.description: The existing hyperlink to edit, or null for a new one.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user saves the dialog.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to on close — the host spreadsheet passes its grid root so focus lands on the grid. Null falls back to the element focused before the dialog opened.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders. Auto follows the viewport scope (a sheet on the narrow one); a forced value pins the mode without measuring, so a test can render the mobile sheet without a DOM.
